segments.title: Staff Presentation on Elm Wood Disposal Initiative
segments.takeaway: Staff presented an overview of the Elm Wood Disposal Initiative, detailing 2024 actions and 2025 proposals to waive disposal fees and enhance DED response.

segments.title: Parks Department Proposal for DED Response
segments.takeaway: The Parks Department proposed a capital project to fund increased DED sweeps, monitoring, testing, and additional urban forestry technicians to combat the disease.

segments.title: By-law Amendment for Elmwood Disposal Fees
segments.takeaway: Administration recommended amending By-law 9844 to formalize the waiving of entrance and tipping fees for all Elmwood loads, aligning with current practice.

segments.title: Commercial Arborist's Perspective on Elm Disposal
segments.takeaway: A commercial arborist supported waiving all Elm disposal fees, highlighted resident confusion, and proposed an organics processing facility to manage Elmwood waste.

segments.title: SOS Trees' Support for Elm Disposal Plan
segments.takeaway: SOS Trees supported the proposed Elmwood disposal plan, urging the removal of all fees and recommending re-applying for a composting pilot and installing beetle traps.

segments.title: Committee Questions for Administration
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration on fee caps, composting approval, tree replanting policies, and the overall strategy to prevent a Dutch Elm Disease epidemic.

segments.title: Elm Wood Disposal Initiative Approved
segments.takeaway: The committee unanimously approved the Elm Wood Disposal Initiative, including waiving all residential and commercial Elmwood disposal fees and amending the waste by-law.
